how: uv run python tools/mutants.py docs/quantities/qt-a3cb/mutants.json --no-baseline --evidence docs/quantities/qt-a3cb/evidence/mutants-run.json, after a passing build. Each mutant is applied alone; its command rebuilds the module whose #guard must fail, or rebuilds ve_service (and the schema), re-pins checkers.lock and runs the service test, restoring the lock and the schema on exit; the four erasure mutants first cut the section of withSizes_eq from Theorems.lean, whose proofs they break, so the #guard is what kills them; the harness restores the mutated file's exact bytes. Lean only: no Python or Rust product code changed. Service mutants run pytest with VE_NATIVE_PREBUILT=1, so the session build (which builds RunExamples, whose three-sort #guard also kills charge-dropped and regionCost-predicates) does not stand in for the named test.

mutants.claim: the region sizes are charged against W6a's budget before they are computed (deliverable 2; the task's seeded bug: the region size left uncharged)
command: L=$(mktemp) && cp lean/checkers.lock "$L" && trap 'cp "$L" lean/checkers.lock' EXIT && (cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build ve_service >/dev/null) && uv run python tools/regen_generated.py --write --only checker-pins >/dev/null && VE_NATIVE_PREBUILT=1 uv run pytest -q -x -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_cardinality_service.py -k charged_before
mutants.test: tests/test_cardinality_service.py::test_region_sizes_are_charged_before_they_are_computed (the chain's third sort is answered, not refused)
